_comment: Editor cover-art image prompt (studio cover generator). positionDescriptions map the UI's position values onto canvas wording; textLines/blocks are assembled by cover_prompt.py.

positionDescriptions.top: upper third of the canvas (approximately top 30% horizontal band)
positionDescriptions.center: central horizontal band of the canvas (middle 30%)
positionDescriptions.bottom: lower third of the canvas (approximately bottom 30% horizontal band)

none.style:
- Style: BOLD FLAT GRAPHIC DESIGN, retail-oriented, high contrast, vibrant colors.
- NOT watercolor, NOT cozy illustrated landscape, NOT photorealistic, NOT painterly, NOT novel cover, NOT 3D book mockup.
none.background: - Full-canvas bold solid-color OR simple two-tone gradient background from the user concept below.

coloring.style: - Style: coloring book cover art with bold, clean black outlines on white, simple shapes, no shading.
coloring.background: - Line art scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

mandala.style: - Style: intricate radially symmetrical mandala line art in black on white, with no shading.
mandala.background: - One large mandala built around the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

ink.style: - Style: hand-drawn ink drawing with confident black pen lines and hatching.
ink.background: - Ink scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

sketch.style: - Style: detailed graphite pencil sketch with soft shading and visible pencil strokes.
sketch.background: - Pencil scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

silhouette.style: - Style: solid black silhouettes with crisp edges and an instantly recognizable outline.
silhouette.background: - Solid or softly graded background from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge, with the silhouette against it.

illustration.style: - Style: polished full-color digital illustration with clean shapes and rich lighting.
illustration.background: - Illustrated scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

cartoon.style: - Style: cheerful full-color cartoon with bold outlines and bright, flat colors.
cartoon.background: - Cartoon scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

storybook.style: - Style: warm storybook illustration with soft textures, gentle colors and a hand-painted feel.
storybook.background: - Storybook scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

vintage.style: - Style: vintage retro poster art with a limited muted palette and a light printed grain.
vintage.background: - Retro scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

watercolor.style: - Style: traditional watercolor painting with soft washes, gentle color bleeds and visible paper texture.
watercolor.background: - Painted scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

oil_painting.style: - Style: classic oil painting with rich colors and visible brushstrokes.
oil_painting.background: - Painted scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

photo.style: - Style: realistic, natural-looking photograph with soft lighting and true-to-life colors.
photo.background: - Photographic scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

render_3d.style: - Style: polished 3D render with soft studio lighting and smooth materials. Render the scene, not a 3D model of a book.
render_3d.background: - 3D scene from the user concept below, filling the canvas edge to edge.

typographyBlock:
COVER TYPOGRAPHY (render only the exact text listed below; do not invent or substitute other words):
{cover_text_section}

Typography rules:
- Use the EXACT spelling shown above. Do not paraphrase, abbreviate, or use placeholder words.
- Title: largest and boldest text on the cover; legible at Amazon thumbnail size.
- Subtitle: clearly smaller than the title.
- Author: smallest of the three, clean byline style.
- High contrast between text and background; balance text within each zone.

textRules.withText: 1. Render only the cover typography listed above. Do not add any other words, slogans, or labels beyond what the user specified.
textRules.withoutText: 1. NO title text, subtitle, author name, slogans, or decorative phrases in the image: artwork only.
